meta.Annotated videos: Three MP4 files in this folder, one per clip

headlineFindings: Dry and bare ground is the dominant problem, exactly as recorded on site. Bare ground averages 15-23% of frame across the three zones, with 1,312 bare-patch and 363 dry-plant growth detections across the survey.

Lawn coverage is low for a park of this formality - 11-22% of frame, worst in the formal-beds zone at 11.2%. The turf is patchy rather than continuous, matching the site note of low lawn cover and poor landform symmetry.
Cleanliness is weakest on the central axis at 38/100, driven by loose ground debris across the paved garden beds and its surrounding lawns.
The built framework is in reasonable order - 1,092 kerb and edging runs, 282 benches and the paved avenues were all found and scored. The axial geometry reads clearly in the nadir passes.
Tree tree cover and clipped topiary are healthy: 2,120 tree cover and 1,970 shrub detections, with the palm avenue in good condition. The problem is the ground plane, not the planting above it.
Vehicles were detected inside the park boundary.
Standing water is minimal at 0.9% of frame - this park's problem is the opposite of Smriti Van's.

recommendations.Category: A1 Plantation & Green Cover / A3 watering
recommendations.Finding: Bare and dry ground averages 15-23% of frame across all three zones and lawn cover is only 11-22%. This is the park's dominant defect and matches the site record.
recommendations.Recommended action: Commission a turf reinstatement programme: decompact, level, top-dress and re-turf the failed areas, then correct the watering coverage that allowed them to fail. Prioritise the formal-beds zone.

recommendations.Finding: Hoses are lying across the lawns rather than a fixed watering system operating, and the dry-patch pattern is uneven - consistent with manual watering that does not reach the whole ground plane.
recommendations.Recommended action: Audit the watering layout against the dry-patch map in this report; install or repair fixed watering to the areas that are consistently missed.

recommendations.Finding: Loose ground debris drives the central axis to 38/100, the weakest cleanliness score in the park.
recommendations.Recommended action: Increase sweeping frequency on the paved garden beds and avenues; clear leaf fall from the bed edges.

recommendations.Finding: The formal axial geometry is intact but the ground plane inside it is patchy, so the designed symmetry does not read on the ground.
recommendations.Recommended action: Treat turf reinstatement as a landscape-quality objective, not just horticulture - the garden beds and avenue frames need continuous green to work visually.

recommendations.Finding: Vehicles were detected inside the park boundary.
recommendations.Recommended action: Confirm whether the movements are allowed maintenance access; otherwise enforce vehicle restrictions.

recommendations.Finding: Tree tree cover, topiary, kerbs, benches and paved avenues are all in reasonable condition.
recommendations.Recommended action: Maintain the current regime for planting and hardscape; the investment needed is in the ground plane.

recommendations.Finding: Items recorded on site with no detector class yet: flower beds, weeds near pathways, water pipes and leakage, dustbins, gates, gazebo, signposts, streetlights, parking, boundary wall and railings as distinct classes.
recommendations.Recommended action: Confirm which matter most for the DDA report and they can be added. Flower beds and weeds-near-pathways are both straightforward and directly relevant to this park.

recommendations.Finding: The saturated-colour rule reports 681 play-equipment and 331 gym-equipment records in a park where none was observed - it is catching red benches and planter edging.
recommendations.Recommended action: Treat those two rows as unverified. A scene-level gate similar to the one used for construction can suppress them per park on request.

recommendations.Finding: No .SRT telemetry accompanied these clips, and this is a single-date capture.
recommendations.Recommended action: Export flight logs with the video to unlock geo-tagging, the issue map and pavement lengths in metres; repeat the same flight path later for change detection against this baseline.
